buildProposal.decision: Implement the authorized issue 327 integrated Account to Prepare to Brief to Refine product design in shared C3.
buildProposal.scope: Shared C3 presentation, contextual evidence and continuous revision with session-only note and stale-edit recovery, relevant regression tests and concise product direction and preview guide. Preserve both Utah and Missouri paths, source and raw-model identity, operation and record binding, honest recorded and unavailable modes. No new live product model calls, retrieval, new recording acquisition, provider or spend-route activation, durable product writes, assignment, sharing, content approval, outreach, deployment, migrations or protection changes. Require independent technical review, exact-tree full gates, exact-head hosted checks and ordinary checked merge. Agent verification is not customer acceptance or human approval.
